{{Top|leg}}
An '''assault tube''' was used by [[Starship/Legends|starships]] to board enemy vessels. When deployed, the assault tube would penetrate the hull of a target vessel and create a pressurized seal. Boarders could then enter the tube via an [[Airlock/Legends|airlock]]. The ''[[Worthless Fool]]'' was equipped with an assault tube.
